class.name: LeafFall3D
class.brief_description: Falling and blown leaves in the shared wind.

method.name: add_crown
method.description: Adds a crown that sheds: its middle [param center], its ellipsoid half sizes [param radii], its leaf [param kind] and the leaves it holds. It sheds [member shed_rate] of them a day. Returns its index.

method.name: add_kind
method.description: Adds a leaf kind: its [param mesh] at true size (chord along x, blade normal along y), its chord [param length] (m), one-sided [param area] (m2), [param mass] (kg) and [param flutter] (0: falls straight like a needle, 1: a broad leaf's full lift and tumbling). Returns its index.

method.name: add_tree_kinds
method.description: Adds [param variants] leaf kinds for a [TreeGenerator] [param preset] in [param season] (curled and dead brown variants), with dry leaves' mass when [param dry]. Crowns given the returned first kind pick among all of them.

method.name: clear_crowns
method.description: Removes every crown.

method.name: clear_kinds
method.description: Removes every leaf kind and the leaves in the air.

method.name: drop_leaf
method.description: Drops one leaf of [param kind] at [param position] now.

method.name: get_buried_count
method.description: Lying leaves that snow has fallen over ([method WorldSnow.surface_at] above them); they stay put until it melts.

method.name: get_crown_count
method.description: The number of crowns, added by hand and automatic.

method.name: get_floating_count
method.description: Leaves floating on open water ([WorldWater]): carried by its current plus [member leeway] of the wind.

method.name: get_kind_count
method.description: The number of leaf kinds.

method.name: get_kicked_count
method.description: Leaves thrown up so far by moving bodies in the [code]world_contact[/code] group passing through them.

method.name: get_leaf_count
method.description: The leaves alive now, in the air and lying.

method.name: get_leaf_normals
method.description: Each live leaf's blade normal, for checks.

method.name: get_leaf_states
method.description: Each live leaf's position, with w 1 when it lies on the ground.

method.name: get_leaf_velocities
method.description: Each live leaf's velocity (m/s), for checks.

method.name: get_lifted_count
method.description: Leaves the wind has lifted off the ground so far.

method.name: get_preset_shed_daily
method.description: The share of a tree [param preset]'s leaves that the automatic crowns shed a day now, or -1 when no crown of it is near.

method.name: get_step_time
method.description: The last step's time (ms).

method.name: refresh_crowns_near
method.description: Takes the automatic crowns round [param position] now (they refresh round the camera every 2 s on their own).

method.name: simulate_plate
method.description: Steps one leaf alone through the plate model for [param seconds], in still air or a steady [param wind], from a tilt of [param tilt_degrees], and returns its path as (x, y, z, angle of the normal from up in degrees).

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the crowns near the camera come from the scene's [VegetationField3D] nodes (see [member vegetation_field]), with leaf kinds from each tree's preset, and each sheds with its species' season. Crowns added with [method add_crown] are kept.
Leaf area index of the automatic crowns (one-sided leaf area per crown ground area), which sets how many leaves a crown holds.
Share of the 10 m wind that a leaf floating on water drifts at, on top of the water's current (about 3% for flat floating debris, Breivik et al. 2011).
Seconds a leaf lies on the ground before it is recycled (it joins the litter).
Wind speed (m/s) at 10 cm above the ground that lifts loose dry leaves.
Loose leaves per m2 on the ground round the camera that gusts can take up.
The most leaves alive at once.
Distance (m) from the camera within which crowns shed and leaves are kept.
Share of a hand-added crown's leaves that the season alone sheds a day. Automatic crowns take their share from the trees' season instead.
The one [VegetationField3D] the automatic crowns come from. Empty: every one in the scene.
The [WeatherMap3D] whose wind moves the leaves. Empty: the active one.
Extra shedding in a 10 m/s wind, as a multiple of the season's. It grows with the cube of the wind above 3 m/s.
